title: papaver somniferum proles officinale
intro: Papaver somniferum proles officinale, commonly known as opium poppy, is a plant species within the Papaver somniferum complex, known for its medicinal and illicit uses. This plant has been used to treat various health conditions, including pain relief, insomnia, and coughs, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Papaver somniferum proles officinale include analgesia, sedation, and antitussive effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as alkaloids like morphine, codeine, and thebaine. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been found to have analgesic, sedative, and antitussive properties, making it a valuable medicinal resource.
